text:
sylvia: Found an entry in staging logs where a Vault transit/decrypt result was written to stdout by a helper process. It contains a DB password for `billing-worker`. Need rotation + RBAC check.

ben: Can you paste a redacted snippet and which pod?

sylvia: Redacted: `{"billing_db":"password=***REDACTED***"}`. Pod: staging-billing-0 (ns=billing). Timestamp ~2026-03-25T09:12Z.

arjun: Immediate plan: 1) quarantine log blob, 2) rotate the billing DB credential in Vault (create new version), 3) restart consumers, 4) tighten transit permissions for billing-sa. I can run rotation.

sylvia: Quarantined the log to gs://sec-quarantine/5043210001/log.json and disabled egress on that pod.

arjun: Rotation done: new secret at secret/staging/billing/db v3. Consumers restarted and validated. Old secret v2 marked deprecated.

ben: RBAC: billing-sa currently has `transit:decrypt` for transit/* and kv:read for secret/* across namespace. Propose scoping to only `transit/keys/billing-key` and secret path `secret/staging/billing/*`. I'll submit a PR to replace the ClusterRole with a Namespaced Role.

sylvia: Also add an audit alert: if an unwrap event is followed by a log write within 30s from the same pod, trigger high priority.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Added alert rule for unwrap->log correlation and created infra ticket INF-8010 to constrain transit roles via OPA. Quick scan shows no other unwrap+log patterns in last 7 days.

arjun: Patch merged to limit billing-sa perms and clusterrolebinding removed at 11:45Z. Ben, please run `kubectl auth can-i decrypt --as=system:serviceaccount:billing:billing-sa -n staging`.

ben: Smoke check: returns no for generic transit/*, yes for transit/keys/billing-key. Good.

sylvia: Postmortem owner: sylvia. Remediations: remove debug logging wrappers, add lint to CI to detect `transit.Decrypt` without redaction, enforce monthly rotation for billing DB creds, and tighten default SA perms.

sec-bot: sec-bot: Final scan clear. Locking thread in 24h if no objections. :lock:
